review_locator: PMCID:PMC6242976, The Pleiotropic Immunomodulatory Functions of IL-33 and Its Implications in Tumor Immunity; PMID:34985928, Emerging Functions of IL-33 in Homeostasis and Immunity
primary_title: IL-33 promotes IL-10 production in macrophages: a role for IL-33 in macrophage foam cell formation
decision_basis: Promote exact IL33-to-IL10 gene bridge because the cited primary supports IL-33→ERK1/2→STAT3-dependent IL10 promoter activation, transcript induction and secreted IL-10 output in human macrophage-derived foam cells.
limitations_preserved: Human macrophage-derived foam-cell model and stimulus context; distinguish IL10 transcript from secreted IL-10 protein and downstream IL10 receptor signaling; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.
